foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    cs=[j for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if g[i][j]==3]
    if not seeds: return g
    par=(seeds[0][0]+seeds[0][1])%2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            if (i+j)%2==par: g[i][j]=3
    return g
